title: Precision Tracked Transformer via Kalman Filtering, Kriging and Process Noise
authors: Bo Long; Deepak Agarwal; Jelena Markovic-Voronov; Yi Wang; Liuqing Li

why_relevant: Proposes a Bayesian/Kalman-filter Transformer that handles token-level uncertainty, with one experiment on RAG QA with Contriever distractors showing improved robustness to noisy context.
